function Catalog.getPrice(charDef)
	return charDef.rate * Config.PRICE_MULTIPLIER
end

--- Pick a random character, weighted by its rarity's spawn weight.
function Catalog.pickCharacter()
	local roll = math.random() * 100
	local acc = 0
	local rarityName = "Common"
	for name, rarityDef in pairs(Catalog.RARITIES) do
		acc = acc + rarityDef.weight
		if roll <= acc then
			rarityName = name
			break
		end
	end
	local pool = {}
	for _, charDef in ipairs(Catalog.CHARACTERS) do
		if charDef.rarity == rarityName then
			table.insert(pool, charDef)
		end
	end
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

--- Roll a mutation: Rainbow 1%, Diamond 4%, Golden 12%, else none.
function Catalog.rollMutation()
	local roll = math.random()
	if roll < Catalog.MUTATIONS.Rainbow.chance then
		return "Rainbow"
	elseif roll < Catalog.MUTATIONS.Rainbow.chance + Catalog.MUTATIONS.Diamond.chance then
		return "Diamond"
	elseif roll < Catalog.MUTATIONS.Rainbow.chance + Catalog.MUTATIONS.Diamond.chance + Catalog.MUTATIONS.Golden.chance then
		return "Golden"
	end
	return ""
end

--- The income multiplier a mutation gives (1 when there is none).
function Catalog.mutationMultiplier(mutationName)
	if mutationName == "" then
		return 1
	end
	local mutationDef = Catalog.MUTATIONS[mutationName]
	return mutationDef.multiplier
end

return Catalog

-- Brainrot Bay — server entrypoint.
-- Builds the world, creates the RemoteEvents, wires players and starts every
-- system: conveyor, income ticks, stealing and the tsunami.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local State = require(script.State)
local Plots = require(script.Plots)
local Conveyor = require(script.Conveyor)
local Economy = require(script.Economy)
local Steal = require(script.Steal)
local Events = require(script.Events)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.WorldBuilder)

-- RemoteEvents, one folder in ReplicatedStorage.
local remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
remotes.Name = "Remotes"
remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
for _, eventName in ipairs({ "HudUpdate", "HudNotify", "HudBanner", "LockRequest", "RebirthRequest", "UpgradeRequest" }) do
	local event = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	event.Name = eventName
	event.Parent = remotes
end

WorldBuilder.build()
local brainrotFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
brainrotFolder.Name = "Brainrots"
brainrotFolder.Parent = workspace

local function placeCharacter(state, character)
	task.spawn(function()
		local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		if rootPart ~= nil then
			rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Config.SPAWN_POSITION)
		end
		State.applyWalkSpeed(state, false)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local state = State.newPlayer(player)
	state.plotId = Plots.claim(player)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local cashValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	cashValue.Name = "Cash"
	cashValue.Value = state.cash
	cashValue.Parent = leaderstats
	local incomeValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	incomeValue.Name = "Income"
	incomeValue.Value = 0
	incomeValue.Parent = leaderstats
	local rebirthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	rebirthValue.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirthValue.Value = 0
	rebirthValue.Parent = leaderstats

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		placeCharacter(state, character)
	end)
	if player.Character ~= nil then
		placeCharacter(state, player.Character)
	end
	Economy.pushState(remotes, player)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local state = State.get(player)
	if state ~= nil then
		for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	Plots.release(player)
	State.removePlayer(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

remotes.LockRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	Economy.lockBase(remotes, player)
end)
remotes.RebirthRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	Economy.rebirth(remotes, player)
end)
remotes.UpgradeRequest.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, kind)
	Economy.buyUpgrade(remotes, player, kind)
end)

Conveyor.start(function(player, brainrotId)
	Economy.handleClick(remotes, player, brainrotId)
end, brainrotFolder)
Steal.start(remotes)
Events.start(remotes)
Economy.tickLoop(remotes)

-- Brainrot Bay — builds a brainrot's 3D model from plain parts.
-- One body block in the character's colour, a head, a head accessory and a
-- floating billboard with name, rarity, $/s and price. No meshes, no assets.
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)
local Catalog = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Catalog)

local BrainrotFactory = {}

local function makePart(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	return part
end

--- The head accessory parts for a character's `accessory` word.
-- Returns a list of {part, offset} pairs; offsets are relative to the
-- accessory's anchor point above the head.
local function makeAccessory(accessory, size, bodyColor)
	local parts = {}
	if accessory == "none" then
		return parts
	end
	local anchorY = size + size * 0.75
	if accessory == "crown" then
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("Crown", Vector3.new(size * 0.7, size * 0.3, size * 0.7), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), Enum.Material.Neon),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY, 0),
		})
	elseif accessory == "cap" then
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("Cap", Vector3.new(size * 0.8, size * 0.25, size * 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY, 0),
		})
	elseif accessory == "glasses" then
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("Glasses", Vector3.new(size * 0.9, size * 0.18, size * 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY, size * 0.35),
		})
	elseif accessory == "bow" then
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("Bow", Vector3.new(size * 0.6, size * 0.2, size * 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 200), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY, size * 0.4),
		})
	elseif accessory == "antenna" then
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("Antenna", Vector3.new(size * 0.15, size * 0.7, size * 0.15), Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), Enum.Material.Metal),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY + size * 0.2, 0),
		})
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("AntennaTip", Vector3.new(size * 0.3, size * 0.3, size * 0.3), Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60), Enum.Material.Neon),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY + size * 0.55, 0),
		})
	else -- "hat" and anything else: a wide brim hat
		table.insert(parts, {
			part = makePart("Hat", Vector3.new(size * 1.1, size * 0.2, size * 1.1), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 80), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic),
			offset = Vector3.new(0, anchorY, 0),
		})
	end
	return parts
end

--- Two eyes + a mouth on the front (+Z) face of the head, so every
-- brainrot has a face. Returns a list of {part, offset} pairs; offsets
-- are relative to the ground `position`, like makeAccessory.
local function makeFace(size)
	local parts = {}
	local faceColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	local frontZ = size * 0.35 + size * 0.03
	table.insert(parts, {
		part = makePart("EyeLeft", Vector3.new(size * 0.12, size * 0.16, size * 0.05), faceColor),
		offset = Vector3.new(-size * 0.16, size * 1.43, frontZ),
	})
	table.insert(parts, {
		part = makePart("EyeRight", Vector3.new(size * 0.12, size * 0.16, size * 0.05), faceColor),
		offset = Vector3.new(size * 0.16, size * 1.43, frontZ),
	})
	table.insert(parts, {
		part = makePart("Mouth", Vector3.new(size * 0.28, size * 0.08, size * 0.05), faceColor),
		offset = Vector3.new(0, size * 1.20, frontZ),
	})
	return parts
end

--- Build a brainrot model for a character + mutation, standing at `position`
-- (the ground position under its feet). Returns the model.
function BrainrotFactory.create(charDef, mutationName, position, stagger)
	local size = charDef.size
	local bodyColor = charDef.color
	if mutationName ~= "" then
		local mutationDef = Catalog.MUTATIONS[mutationName]
		bodyColor = mutationDef.color
	end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = charDef.name

	local body = makePart("Body", Vector3.new(size, size, size), bodyColor)
	body.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, size / 2, 0)
	body.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = body

	local head = makePart("Head", Vector3.new(size * 0.7, size * 0.7, size * 0.7), bodyColor)
	head.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, size + size * 0.35, 0)
	head.Parent = model

	local accessoryParts = makeAccessory(charDef.accessory, size, bodyColor)
	for _, entry in ipairs(accessoryParts) do
		entry.part.Position = position + entry.offset
		entry.part.Parent = model
	end

	local faceParts = makeFace(size)
	for _, entry in ipairs(faceParts) do
		entry.part.Position = position + entry.offset
		entry.part.Parent = model
	end

	local rarityDef = Catalog.RARITIES[charDef.rarity]
	local price = Catalog.getPrice(charDef)
	local mult = Catalog.mutationMultiplier(mutationName)
	local displayName = charDef.name
	if mutationName ~= "" then
		displayName = mutationName .. " " .. charDef.name
	end

	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "Label"
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Config.BILLBOARD_WIDTH, Config.BILLBOARD_HEIGHT)
	billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, size + 1.2 + (stagger or 0) * Config.BILLBOARD_STAGGER, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.Adornee = body
	billboard.Parent = body

	local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	nameLabel.Name = "Name"
	nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.34, 0)
	nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	nameLabel.Text = displayName
	nameLabel.TextSize = Config.BILLBOARD_NAME_SIZE
	nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	nameLabel.Parent = billboard

	local rarityLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

-- The server is authoritative: the client only asks, every rule is checked here.

	if state == nil then

	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats ~= nil then
		local cashValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Cash")
		local incomeValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Income")
		local rebirthValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")

			cashValue.Value = state.cash
		end
		if incomeValue ~= nil then

		end

			rebirthValue.Value = state.rebirths
		end
	end

		event:FireClient(player, state.cash, income, state.rebirths, state.speedLevel, state.incomeLevel)
	end
end

--- Where an owned brainrot stands on its plot.
local function placeOnPlot(record)
	local ground = Plots.slotPosition(record.plotId, record.slotIndex)
	local size = record.model:GetAttribute("Size")
	record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ground.X, ground.Y + size / 2, ground.Z))
end

--- Handle a click on a brainrot: buy it off the belt, sell your own, or
-- start a steal on somebody else's.
function Economy.handleClick(remotes, player, brainrotId)
	local state = State.get(player)
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	local record = Conveyor.belt[brainrotId]
	if record ~= nil then
		-- On the belt: buy it.
		if state.cash < record.price then
			Economy.notify(remotes, player, string.format("Need $%d for %s!", record.price, record.charName))
			return
		end
		if state.plotId == 0 then
			Economy.notify(remotes, player, "No free plot yet, wait a moment!")
			return
		end
		local taken = {}
		for _, owned in pairs(state.owned) do
			if owned.plotId == state.plotId then
				taken[owned.slotIndex] = true
			end
		end
		local slotIndex = Plots.freeSlot(taken)
		if slotIndex == 0 then
			Economy.notify(remotes, player, "Your base is full! Sell or rebirth first.")
			return
		end
		state.cash = state.cash - record.price
		Conveyor.belt[brainrotId] = nil
		record.owner = player
		record.plotId = state.plotId
		record.slotIndex = slotIndex
		state.owned[record.id] = record
		placeOnPlot(record)
		Economy.notify(remotes, player, string.format("Bought %s for $%d!", record.charName, record.price))
		Economy.pushState(remotes, player)
		return
	end
	-- Not on the belt: find whose base it lives on.
	for _, otherState in pairs(State.players) do
		local owned = otherState.owned[brainrotId]
		if owned ~= nil then
			if owned.owner == player then
				-- Your own brainrot: sell it for a 50% refund.
				local refund = math.floor(owned.price * Config.SELL_REFUND)
				state.cash = state.cash + refund
				owned.model:Destroy()
				state.owned[brainrotId] = nil

				Economy.pushState(remotes, player)
			else

				if income > 0 then
					state.cash = state.cash + income
				end

	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	local cost = Config.REBIRTH_BASE_COST * (state.rebirths + 1)
	if state.cash < cost then
		Economy.notify(remotes, player, string.format("Rebirth costs $%d!", cost))
		return
	end
	for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
		record.model:Destroy()
	end
	state.owned = {}
	state.cash = Config.START_CASH
	state.rebirths = state.rebirths + 1

	if state == nil then

		return

	if kind == "Speed" then

	else

	end

	if state.cash < cost then
		Economy.notify(remotes, player, string.format("%s level %d costs $%d!", upgradeDef.name, level + 1, cost))
		return
	end
	state.cash = state.cash - cost
	if kind == "Speed" then
		state.speedLevel = state.speedLevel + 1
		State.applyWalkSpeed(state, false)
	else
		state.incomeLevel = state.incomeLevel + 1
	end

-- Brainrot Bay — base plots.
-- Eight plots, six slots each. A plot is claimed when a player joins and
-- released when they leave. The colour of a plot always comes from
-- Config.PLOT_COLORS, keyed by plot id — never from a PLOTS entry, which

		if Plots.ownerByPlot[plotEntry.id] == nil then
			Plots.ownerByPlot[plotEntry.id] = player
			Plots.plotByPlayer[player] = plotEntry.id
			return plotEntry.id
		end
	end
	return 0
end

--- Release a player's plot (on leave).
function Plots.release(player)
	local plotId = Plots.plotByPlayer[player]
	if plotId ~= nil then
		Plots.ownerByPlot[plotId] = nil
		Plots.plotByPlayer[player] = nil
	end

--- The plot a player owns, or 0.

	return Plots.plotByPlayer[player] or 0
end

--- Plot info: id, centre and colour. The colour is looked up in
-- Config.PLOT_COLORS by id — this is the only correct source for it.
function Plots.get(plotId)

	if plotEntry == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local plotInfo = {
		id = plotEntry.id,
		center = plotEntry.center,
		color = Config.PLOT_COLORS[plotEntry.id],
	}
	return plotInfo
end

--- The world position of a slot on a plot (ground level, on the pad).

	local offset = Config.SLOT_OFFSETS[slotIndex]

		return Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	return plotInfo.center + offset + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)

-- Every player has exactly one state record; every module reads and writes
-- through here, never through its own copy.
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)

local State = {}
State.players = {}

	local state = {
		player = player,
		cash = Config.START_CASH,
		rebirths = 0,
		speedLevel = 0,
		incomeLevel = 0,
		plotId = 0,
		lockUntil = 0,
		lockCooldownUntil = 0,
		owned = {},
	}
	State.players[player] = state
	return state
end

function State.get(player)
	return State.players[player]
end

function State.removePlayer(player)
	State.players[player] = nil
end

--- A player's income per second: every owned brainrot's rate times its
-- mutation multiplier, boosted by rebirths and the Income upgrade.
function State.recalcIncome(state)
	local base = 0
	for _, record in pairs(state.owned) do
		base = base + record.rate * record.mult
	end
	local upgradeDef = Config.UPGRADES.Income
	local incomeBoost = 1 + upgradeDef.bonusPerLevel * state.incomeLevel
	local rebirthBoost = 1 + Config.REBIRTH_BONUS * state.rebirths
	return math.floor(base * incomeBoost * rebirthBoost)
end

--- The walk speed a player should have right now.
function State.walkSpeed(state, carrying)
	if carrying then
		return Config.STEAL_SLOW_SPEED
	end
	local upgradeDef = Config.UPGRADES.Speed
	return Config.BASE_WALK_SPEED + upgradeDef.bonusPerLevel * state.speedLevel
end

--- Apply the state's walk speed to the player's humanoid, if it exists.
function State.applyWalkSpeed(state, carrying)
	local character = state.player.Character
	if character == nil then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid ~= nil then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = State.walkSpeed(state, carrying)
	end

-- Brainrot Bay — stealing.
-- Click another player's brainrot to carry it home: you walk slower, you
-- have STEAL_TIME seconds to reach your own plot, and the owner can yank
-- it back by coming within STEAL_YANK_RANGE studs. A locked base cannot
-- be stolen from at all.
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)
local State = require(script.Parent.State)
local Plots = require(script.Parent.Plots)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)

local Steal = {}
Steal.active = {}

--- Start carrying a brainrot home. `record` is the victim's owned record.
function Steal.startSteal(remotes, thief, record)
	local victim = record.owner
	local victimState = State.get(victim)
	local thiefState = State.get(thief)
	if victimState == nil or thiefState == nil then
		return
	end
	if Steal.active[record.id] ~= nil then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() < victimState.lockUntil then
		Economy.notify(remotes, thief, "That base is locked!")
		return
	end
	if thiefState.plotId == 0 then
		Economy.notify(remotes, thief, "You have no base to steal to!")
		return
	end
	local taken = {}
	for _, owned in pairs(thiefState.owned) do
		if owned.plotId == thiefState.plotId then
			taken[owned.slotIndex] = true
		end
	end
	if Plots.freeSlot(taken) == 0 then
		Economy.notify(remotes, thief, "Your base is full — no room for a stolen brainrot!")
		return
	end

	victimState.owned[record.id] = nil
	Steal.active[record.id] = {
		record = record,
		thief = thief,
		victim = victim,
		deadline = os.clock() + Config.STEAL_TIME,
	}
	State.applyWalkSpeed(thiefState, true)
	Economy.notify(remotes, thief, string.format("Stealing %s! Get it to your base!", record.charName))
	Economy.notify(remotes, victim, string.format("%s is stealing your %s! Get close to yank it back!", thief.Name, record.charName))
end

--- The carried brainrot goes back to its owner's plot.
local function returnToOwner(remotes, steal)
	local record = steal.record
	local victimState = State.get(steal.victim)
	if victimState ~= nil then
		local taken = {}
		for _, owned in pairs(victimState.owned) do
			if owned.plotId == record.plotId then
				taken[owned.slotIndex] = true
			end
		end
		local slotIndex = Plots.freeSlot(taken)
		if slotIndex ~= 0 then
			record.slotIndex = slotIndex
			victimState.owned[record.id] = record
			local ground = Plots.slotPosition(record.plotId, record.slotIndex)
			local size = record.model:GetAttribute("Size")
			record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ground.X, ground.Y + size / 2, ground.Z))
		else
			record.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local thiefState = State.get(steal.thief)
	if thiefState ~= nil then
		State.applyWalkSpeed(thiefState, false)
	end
	Steal.active[record.id] = nil
end

--- One step of the steal loop: carry the model, check the yank, the
-- deadline and the arrival home.
function Steal.step(remotes)
	for id, steal in pairs(Steal.active) do
		local record = steal.record
		local thiefState = State.get(steal.thief)
		local thiefCharacter = steal.thief.Character
		local rootPart = nil
		if thiefCharacter ~= nil then
			rootPart = thiefCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
		if thiefState == nil or rootPart == nil then
			returnToOwner(remotes, steal)
		else
			-- Carry it just in front of the thief.
			record.model:PivotTo(rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3))
			local victimCharacter = steal.victim.Character
			local victimRoot = nil
			if victimCharacter ~= nil then
				victimRoot = victimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end
			if victimRoot ~= nil and (victimRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude <= Config.STEAL_YANK_RANGE then
				Economy.notify(remotes, steal.thief, "Yanked back! The owner caught you.")

						end
					end
					local slotIndex = Plots.freeSlot(taken)

					else

						record.plotId = thiefState.plotId
						record.slotIndex = slotIndex
						thiefState.owned[record.id] = record
						local ground = Plots.slotPosition(record.plotId, record.slotIndex)
						local size = record.model:GetAttribute("Size")
						record.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(ground.X, ground.Y + size / 2, ground.Z))
						State.applyWalkSpeed(thiefState, false)
						Economy.notify(remotes, steal.thief, string.format("Stole %s! Nice one!", record.charName))
						Economy.notify(remotes, steal.victim, string.format("%s stole your %s!", steal.thief.Name, record.charName))
						Economy.pushState(remotes, steal.thief)
						Economy.pushState(remotes, steal.victim)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
